headings.title: Commands Deprecated or Removed in BIG-IP LTM 15.0.0

text:
BIG-IP LTM v15.0.0
Commands Introduced in BIG-IP LTM 15.0.0
ANTIFRAUD::client_id
- Returns client id collected on client side.
ANTIFRAUD::device_id
- Returns device id generated by BIG-IP.
ANTIFRAUD::geo
- returns L3 geoIP and geolocation collected by client
ANTIFRAUD::guid
- returns GUID value, only in context of ANTIFRAUD_LOGIN event
ASM::deception
- Marks a request as deceptive for further enforcement by ASM.
DIAMETER::dynamic_route_insertion
- Set whether dynamic route
insertion is enabled.
DIAMETER::dynamic_route_lookup
- Set whether messages should be
routed dynamically.
IKE::auth_success
-
IKE::cert
-
IKE::san_dirname
-
IKE::san_dns
-
IKE::san_ediparty
-
IKE::san_email
-
IKE::san_ipadd
-
IKE::san_othername
-
IKE::san_rid
-
IKE::san_uri
-
IKE::san_x400
-
IKE::subjectAltName
-
OFFBOX::request
- Performs a request with a payload to certain service.
radius_authenticate
- creates and sends a RADIUS access request message and returns the result
SIPALG::hairpin
- Gets or sets the value of hairpin flag for the current message.
SIPALG::hairpin_default
- Gets or sets the value of hairpin flag for the
current connection.
SIPALG::nonregister_subscriber_listener
- Gets or sets
the value of flag enabling creating an ephemeral listener for nonregistered subscribers.
TAP::action
- Returns or updates security token action.
TAP::config
- Returns the current value of the specified setting in an assigned TAP Application.
TAP::score
- Returns or updates risk score.
Commands Updated in BIG-IP LTM 15.0.0
MR::message
- returns the
persistence key being used for the current message
SSL::forward_proxy
- gets or sets the policy status, or handshake and certificate
details for forward proxy connections
Events Introduced in BIG-IP LTM 15.0.0
IKE_AUTH
- Triggered
during IPsec IKE_AUTH for IKEv2 ike-peers
PEM_SUBS_SESS_DELETED
- triggered
when a subscriber session has been deleted.
PEM_SUBS_SESS_UPDATED
- triggered
when a subscriber session attribute has been updated.
TAP_REQUEST
- Triggered once security token obtained.
Events Updated in BIG-IP LTM 15.0.0
PEM_SUBS_SESS_CREATED
- triggered
when a subscriber session is created
Commands Deprecated or Removed in BIG-IP LTM 15.0.0
QOE::disable
QOE::enable
QOE::video
